subject: SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA ESTABLISHED, THE RELEVANT REQUIREMENTS
text:
A4484/26 NOTAMN Q) ZXXX/QXXXX/IV/NBO/W/000/999/3954N11623E162 A) ZBPE ZYSH ZSHA  PART 1 OF 3  B) 2609191600  C) PERM  E) SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA ESTABLISHED, THE RELEVANT REQUIREMENTS 
AS FOLLOWS: 
1. NAME AND IDENTIFICATION 
SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA (ZB(SR)801) 
2. LATERAL LIMITS: A CIRCLE WITH A RADIUS OF 300KM CENTERED AT 
N395410E1162327, BEIJING PROHIBITED AREA (ZB(P)801) NOT INCLUDED. 
VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC-UNL 
EFFECTIVE TIME: H24 
3. SPECIAL RESTRICTIONS 
NO FLIGHT OPERATIONS SHALL BE PERMITTED EXCEPT COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS 
(NOTE 1), BUSINESS FLIGHTS (NOTE 2), AND FLIGHTS FOR MILITARY, 
CUSTOMS, POLICE SERVICES, AND FIRE-FIGHTING RESCUE PURPOSES. 
4. OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS 
4.1 MANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL BE EQUIPPED WITH A SECONDARY 
SURVEILLANCE RADAR (SSR) TRANSPONDER OR OTHER SURVEILLANCE 
EQUIPMENT OF EQUIVALENT PERFORMANCE, WHICH SHALL REMAIN ACTIVATED 
THROUGHOUT THE FLIGHT. UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SHALL HAVE RELIABLE 
SURVEILLANCE CAPABILITY, FITTED WITH AN AIRBORNE OPERATIONAL 
IDENTIFICATION TRANSMITTING MODULE, AN SSR TRANSPONDER OR 
SURVEILLANCE EQUIPMENT OF EQUIVALENT 
F)SFC G)UNL) 
// // PERFORMANCE, WHICH SHALL REMAIN ACTIVATED THROUGHOUT THE 
FLIGHT. 
4.2 PILOTS SHALL MAINTAIN CONTINUOUS TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION WITH 
AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL (ATC) UNIT. REMOTE PILOTS OF UNMANNED AIRCRAFT 
SYSTEM END PART 1 OF 3
A4484/26 NOTAMN Q) ZXXX/QXXXX/IV/NBO/W/000/999/3954N11623E162 A) ZBPE ZYSH ZSHA  PART 2 OF 3  B) 2609191600  C) PERM  E) (UAS) SHALL HAVE RELIABLE MEANS FOR TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION 
WITH ATC UNIT. IN THE EVENT OF LOSS OF TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION, 
PILOTS OR REMOTE PILOTS OF UAS SHALL IMMEDIATELY SET THE SSR 
TRANSPONDER CODE FOR RADIO COMMUNICATION FAILURE, AND TAKE ALL 
FEASIBLE MEASURES TO OBTAIN ACKNOWLEDGEMENT FROM ATC UNIT. 
4.3 PRIOR TO ENTERING THE SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA, AIRCRAFT MUST 
REPORT THEIR SECURITY STATUS (NOTE 3) TO THE ATC UNIT AND 
COOPERATE WITH AIRBORNE TARGET RECOGNITION. WHEN NECESSARY, 
AIRCRAFT WITHIN THE SPECIAL RESTRICTED AREA SHALL BE SUBJECT TO 
AIRBORNE SECURITY VERIFICATION. 
4.4 AIRCRAFT SHALL OPERATE STRICTLY IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE 
APPROVED FLIGHT PLAN. ANY INTENTION OR ACTION TO DEVIATE FROM THE 
FLIGHT PLAN MUST BE REPORTED TO ATC UNIT IN A 
F)SFC G)UNL) 
// // TIMELY MANNER AND APPROVED PRIOR TO EXECUTION. 
4.5 WHEN CIVIL AIRCRAFT OPERATES BELOW 3,000M (INCLUDED) ABOVE 
MEAN SEA LEVEL, THE INDICATED AIRSPEED (IAS) SHOULD NOT EXCEED 
450KMH. 
NOTE: 
1. CALIBRATION FLIGHTS, TEST FLIGHTS, FERRY FLIGHTS, AND 
PRODUCTION FLIGHT TESTS SHALL BE MANAGED IN THE SAME MANNER AS 
COMMERCIAL FLIGHTS. 
2. BUSINESS FLIGHTS REFER TO THOSE FLIGHT ACTIVITIES APPROVED 
UNDER RELEVANT END PART 2 OF 3
A4484/26 NOTAMN Q) ZXXX/QXXXX/IV/NBO/W/000/999/3954N11623E162 A) ZBPE ZYSH ZSHA  PART 3 OF 3  B) 2609191600  C) PERM  E) PROVISIONS, AND OPERATED ON A NON-SCHEDULE BASIS 
WITH NO PASSENGER TICKET FOR THEIR BUSINESS OR ADMINISTRATIVE 
ACTIVITIES, ACCORDING TO THE SLOTS AND AIRPORTS OF DEPARTURE AND 
ARRIVAL SPECIFIED BY AN INDIVIDUAL USER. 
3. THE CONTENT OF SECURITY STATUS REPORT INCLUDES: AIRCRAFT 
IDENTIFICATION (FLIGHT NUMBER, OR AIRCRAFT NATIONALITY AND 
REGISTRATION MARK), SSR TRANSPONDER CODE, CURRENT POSITION, AND 
NORMALITY OF SECURITY STATUS. END PART 3 OF 3 F) SFC  G) UNL)
